ONE-ON-ONE SUPPORT

Salud Integral One-on-One Support

A space to care for yourself, strengthen your habits and cultivate your wellbeing.

Book my session →

At Salud Integral we offer an individual online support space, adapted to your needs, goals and lifestyle. The purpose is to give you practical tools for self-care, emotional regulation and building healthy habits, respecting your pace and your personal circumstances.

Each session is adapted to the topics you want to work on

We can integrate different wellbeing practices and resources, according to your interests and goals:

Emotional wellbeing

Self-regulation tools, stress management and exercises based on principles of cognitive behavioral therapy, aimed at identifying thought patterns and developing practical strategies to face everyday challenges.

Breathing and relaxation

Breathing exercises and mindful attention practices to foster calm and connection with the present moment.

Yoga and Qigong

Practices adapted to your abilities, focused on mindful movement, breathing and the connection between body and mind.

Nutrition and healthy habits

Educational guidance to develop a more conscious relationship with food, organize your routines and build sustainable habits.

Home fermentation

Practical learning about making and handling fermented foods, such as kefir, and including them in a varied diet.

Wellbeing through the different stages of life

Support in adapting to changes in habits and routines related to stages such as menopause, as well as help organizing everyday self-care.

We can also work on personal goals related to wellbeing and lifestyle habits for people who live with conditions such as diabetes, anxiety or depression, from the standpoint of self-care, education and complementary support.

How do the sessions work?

  • Format100% online, through Google Meet.
  • Access linkYou will receive the link to connect 30 minutes before the session.
  • InvestmentUS$50 per session.
  • PaymentPayment is made in advance to confirm and reserve your session.

Each meeting is an individual space in which we define the priority topics and the tools that best fit your goals. The intention is that you can take away practical ideas and exercises to gradually integrate into your everyday life.

A comprehensive approach, at your own pace

Wellbeing is built through small steps, conscious decisions and practices that make sense to you. This support aims to give you educational resources and self-care tools that you can incorporate in a realistic and sustainable way.
